description: An agent may ask a model to think for it. Thinking on its own changes nothing outside FRIDAY, and what it decides to do afterwards is asked about separately.
An agent may check FRIDAY's own health and verify her records, the same as a scheduled job may. Nothing outside FRIDAY is touched.
Compacting the event log rewrites the record of everything FRIDAY has done. She asks first, every time, and a standing permission can never cover it.
